protocol.scope: Fixed HTTP-received source-version cohort recovery with finite field checks, owner review and physical execution; not semantic accuracy, comparative gain or human productivity.
protocol.stopping: Only sealed source dispositions and received local jobs/proposals/queries/inspections/operations/needs; never simulator truth.
protocol.revisionPolicy: Changed/deleted/unversioned changed sealed content remains retained attention; never credited by a stale receipt.
protocol.subsequentSources: Later records are retained and counted separately, outside the fixed recovery denominator.

corpusManifest.reportingPolicy: Physical need at time zero; public source followed by the same delayed formal report for every arm. Source interpretation alone does not authorize a dispatch.
corpusManifest.limitation: Internally authored synthetic cohort. Formal delay and human throughput require sensitivity tests; they are not field measurements.

limitations: Internally authored public text cohort and finite scripted review, not a measured human workforce.
Four independent in-memory databases in one process, not a production deployment.
A valid semantic receipt is acknowledgement/provenance, not precision or fake-news accuracy.
Subsequent records outside the sealed source-version cohort are retained but not credited as recovered.
Pending, rejected, truncated and revised sources remain explicit; no controller stopping uses physical gold.
Recorded public parser substitutes perception: zero paid calls, no GenAI-quality claim.
